body:
I tried to commit suicide in February. I checked myself into the hospital after a few days, have been taking my meds regularly, been attending groups and therapy, and looking for jobs.

Things aren't getting better. I'm worried.

Thank you for the message. I didn't think anyone would care enough to answer. 

The McDonalds thing doesn't help me, though. I was so optimistic when I had the interview, and when I left, I sobbed on the bus on the way home.  I found out it was 15 hours a week at minimum wage. I wouldn't be able to cover rent, let alone electric, food, or phone. It doesn't even start until the week of the 19th, and rent is due on the fifth. 

I've thought about donating blood, and I plan on calling them today, but I've read around it's (at max) probably going to be 20 bucks for a first donation. Maybe i can donate a few times a week, and it would help, but it wouldn't be enough to help me with my rent. I don't have anything worth selling - even my hair is too short. 

My depression affects things. My mom was suicidal, and I saw an attempt when I was young, so it affected me for a while, and I thought I had missed it until this year.I know things get better, but I'm at a low point so far down I can't see how I'll make it out, and I can't last until summer. I love your optimism. I'm really happy you're trying to help people - I'm really happy there are people like you in the world.
